title: Central Chart Visual Dynamics Remediation
implementation_results: Merged WP3E shell geometry is preserved; WP3F changes are concentrated on the central chart and its assurance.
Synthetic candlestick body, border and wick presentation has stronger bullish/bearish contrast without changing OHLC source values.
The former approximate independent SVG mapping has been replaced by exact Lightweight Charts timeToCoordinate and priceToCoordinate binding.
An outer source-derived high/low envelope now wraps the candle path, with an inner open/close body ribbon and restrained high/mid/close/low presentation traces.
The range navigator has increased visual depth while remaining deterministic and presentation-only.
Playwright proves chart/overlay coordinate-box alignment within 1px and preserves the 1536x864 WP3E reference geometry plus responsive viewports.
Fixture/non-evidentiary/authority-none labeling, independent AVAILABLE/AUTHORISED/ACTIVE states, null/residual handling and inactive C2E remain explicit.
